The TradeStation API is a collection of RESTful brokerage and market data services used to build trading applications for stocks, options, futures, and cryptocurrency. The API provides endpoints for account management, order placement and execution, real-time and historical market data, option chains, and symbol information. TradeStation supports advanced order types including bracket, OCO, OSO, and multi-leg options orders, with both intelligent and direct order routing. The API uses OAuth2 authentication and version 3 is the recommended version for new integrations.
